subject: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated vs VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated vs VPC

Thanks again for the time today, Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your evaluation moving: 

Summary of needs
- Primary goal: Validate inference latency and cost at 95th percentile for our real customer traffic (sample workload will be provided).
- Success criteria (proposed): end-to-end 95th pct latency < 250ms for 512 tokens, cost per 1k tokens <= $0.45, and no functional regressions on a set of 100 representative prompts.

Environment options we discussed
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood-hosted sandbox with sample dataset. Quick to provision (2–3 business days). Good for rapid baseline and functional checks.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved): Dedicated GPU pool for more realistic throughput testing. Provisioning ~1–2 weeks depending on capacity.
3) VPC trial (preferred for you): Private VPC deployment (control plane managed by Redwood, workers in your VPC). Best for security and data residency but longer lead time (~3–4 weeks).

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline
- Day 0–3: Provision hosted trial + onboarding doc. Run smoke tests, ingest sample prompts.
- Day 4–10: Run load and latency tests, run evaluation script we’ll provide, collect metrics.
- Day 11–14: Review results, discuss next steps (move to dedicated or schedule VPC onboarding).

Ownership & asks
- Redwood (Marissa): Provision hosted trial, share evaluation script and checklist, weekly sync.
- Redwood (Camila): Technical onboarding and monitoring (point of contact for infra).
- Acme (Alex): Confirm sample workload and a primary technical contact for the VPC conversations (if you want to start that path).

Next steps (please reply)
- Which environment would you like to start with? If VPC, can you share a target date and technical contact?
- Confirm the proposed success criteria or suggest changes.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.xlsx (we'll populate environment-specific items once you pick an option).

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0183

Subject: Re: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated vs VPC

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We are generally leaning toward VPC for production parity because the data is customer-controlled and we have strict logging/KMS requirements. That said, we'd like to start with a hosted sandbox to validate the evaluation scripts and the success criteria quickly, then transition to VPC for the full tests.
- Timeline: starting hosted trial next week would be ideal. For VPC we'd be aiming for late July, but that's flexible.
- Technical contact for VPC: Bethany Lee (bethany.lee@acmeai.com) — I'll loop her in once we lock timelines.

Can you also confirm what level of data masking/scrubbing Redwood can provide for the hosted sandbox? We can't put raw PII into a hosted environment.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of ML Ops, Acme AI

Forwarding Alex's note and adding a quick recommendation:

My suggestion is to provision the hosted sandbox immediately with a requirement that Acme uploads a scrubbed sample dataset. Redwood can run an automated PII scrub step (we replace known PII tokens and hash identifiers) and we can provide an isolated tenant in the hosted sandbox. That will give you fast feedback on latency and model behavior.

Operational notes for provisioning:
- Hosted sandbox: 3 business days to spin up and onboard, includes access to the evaluation script and token-level dashboards.
- Dedicated sandbox: requires capacity approval; estimate 1–2 weeks.
- VPC trial: we'll need a network worksheet (I'll attach) and an SSO/KMS checklist. Provisioning ~3–4 weeks after we get the worksheet.

Attaching: trial-sla.pdf (high-level), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (placeholder).

Acme deliverables (owner)

- Confirm any additional success criteria by EOD Mon, 22 Jun.

- Mon 22 Jun: Hosted sandbox provisioned and onboarding session scheduled.
- Mon 22–Fri 26 Jun: Run evaluation script and gather metrics.
